user.title: Set up Torque OBD-II
user.description: Configure your vehicle for Torque OBD-II integration. The vehicle name will be used to create a unique API endpoint.

error.invalid_vehicle_name: Invalid vehicle name. Use only letters, numbers, spaces, dashes, and underscores.
error.invalid_email: Invalid email format. Please enter a valid email address.

abort.already_configured: This vehicle name is already configured.

menu_options.profiles: Torque profiles and PIDs to ignore
menu_options.pick_pid: Add or edit a sensor definition

profiles.title: Torque profiles for this vehicle
profiles.description: The vehicle is matched automatically when the Torque profile has its name. Torque sometimes sends a numeric ID instead (e.g. 1966413…): such IDs are learned automatically and listed here. Add or remove entries (comma separated). PIDs to ignore: keys of PIDs belonging to another car (e.g. k2101, k2174), comma-separated. Their entities are removed.

data.ignored_pids: PIDs to ignore for this vehicle (e.g. k2101, k2174)

pick_pid.title: Sensor definition
pick_pid.description: Pick a PID received from this vehicle (key — name = last value, ✎ = already defined for this vehicle), or type a key (e.g. k222001, or 222001).

edit_definition.title: Definition of {pid}
edit_definition.description: Applies to this vehicle only and takes precedence over torque_sensor_definitions.yaml. Saving reloads the vehicle: no Home Assistant restart needed. Values outside min / max (e.g. 255 or 655.35 sent when the ECU has no data) are ignored.

delete_definitions.title: Remove definitions
delete_definitions.description: The selected sensors go back to the shared definition (built-in or torque_sensor_definitions.yaml).

import_yaml.title: Import definitions
import_yaml.description: {file} contains {count} definition(s). They are copied into this vehicle's options, where you can then edit them.

data.only_received: Only PIDs received from this vehicle
data.overwrite: Replace definitions already set for this vehicle

error.invalid_pid: Invalid PID key: k followed by the hexadecimal code (e.g. k222001).
error.min_above_max: The maximum must be greater than the minimum.

abort.no_definitions: No sensor definition is set for this vehicle yet.
abort.yaml_missing: No torque_sensor_definitions.yaml file (or it is empty) in the configuration folder.
abort.yaml_invalid: torque_sensor_definitions.yaml cannot be read: check its YAML syntax.
